basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, recently diving into the world of Reddit. I enjoy exploring new technologies, particularly in the realm of blockchain and cryptocurrencies. When I'm not glued to my computer screen, you can find me hiking the local trails or trying out new recipes in the kitchen. I'm currently working as a junior software developer at a startup. As a single guy, I have plenty of time to explore my interests and engage in online communities. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science, which laid the foundation for my current career in software development. I've always been fascinated by technology and have spent countless hours learning about blockchain and cryptocurrencies through online courses and forums.
